package_info.package_name: Font Package (MSI) used by PDF editor app
package_info.why_malicious: The package was compromised to include a hidden cryptocurrency miner, which was deployed to end-user systems with elevated privileges, resulting in unauthorized resource usage and potential system instability.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (after installation of PDF editor app)
execution_context.file_location: Embedded within the MSI font package, executed as part of the PDF editor app process

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Malicious coinminer binary (exact code not shown in report, but described as hidden inside the MSI font package and executed post-installation)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code launches a cryptocurrency mining process using system resources, potentially communicating with external mining pools to exfiltrate mined currency, resulting in unauthorized resource consumption.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code executes a hidden coinminer process without user consent, leveraging elevated privileges granted to the PDF editor app.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Font packages are expected to contain only font files and related resources, not executable code that launches background processes.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate software installers may include optional components, but these are typically disclosed and require user consent.
key_indicators: Hidden executable within a font package
Automatic execution of background mining process
Abuse of system privileges for unauthorized computation

attack_chain.action: Threat actor compromises the cloud server infrastructure of the font package provider and injects a malicious coinminer into the MSI package.
attack_chain.leads_to: Distribution of the compromised package to downstream software vendors.

attack_chain.action: PDF editor app vendor downloads and integrates the compromised font package into their product.
attack_chain.leads_to: End users receive the tainted PDF editor app.

attack_chain.action: End user installs the PDF editor app, which includes the compromised font package.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code is present on the user's system.

attack_chain.action: At runtime, the malicious coinminer code is executed with system privileges, mining cryptocurrency using the user's resources.
attack_chain.leads_to: Unauthorized resource usage and potential exfiltration of mined currency.

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected background processes launched by font or resource packages
High CPU/GPU usage after installation of non-graphics-intensive software
Network connections to known cryptocurrency mining pools
file_indicators: MSI font packages containing executable binaries
Unusual files or processes named similarly to legitimate font resources
network_indicators: Outbound connections to cryptocurrency mining pool domains or IPs
Unexpected network activity from PDF editor or font package processes
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for unexpected executable files or processes launched from within resource packages (such as fonts) after software installation. Analyze MSI packages for embedded executables. Track system resource usage spikes following installation of non-resource-intensive applications. Inspect network traffic for connections to known mining pools or suspicious external endpoints originating from PDF editor or font package processes.
